title: How to easily conditionally display components based on the search state

comments.body:
I don't know if it's relevant to our discussion but I have two use cases that we often see:
- when first displaying the page, display a content page instant of the empty query (a query with no parameters set)
- when there are no results, display a list of all the refinements so that the end-user can discard some of them to get back to a state with results

> when first displaying the page, display a content page instant of the empty query (a query with no parameters set)

Yep that's the <NoQuery> component for example (does not exists today)

> when there are no results, display a list of all the refinements so that the end-user can discard some of them to get back to a state with results

Yes that's the <NoResults> component (exists today)
Also relevant: `<HasItems>` for any list of refinement items. This could provide most of the "autoHideContainer" behavior in V1 for people willing to have it.

Here's an api proposal for the Results/Query conditional display: We could have a `Conditional` widget that will take a `show` prop. This prop will take a function with `(state, results)` as parameters and will expect a boolean in return. Example with the Query/NoQuery example: ```js !state.q}>
No Query entered
 state.q}>
a query is entered
 ``` I voluntarily didn't include the `` one. Right now, with our current state management, I don't see an easy way to show again a facet after it has been hidden (either with clearAll button or by just uncheck other facets). What do you think ?

After second thought, even with the above api, basic limitation appear (like you're not able to access the query when hitting no results). 

In the end, for the release, we're just gonna create a "Conditional Display" guide explaining how to use the `createConnector` function to build it.
